scope.purpose: One provider capability observation, not deposit interpretation or accuracy evidence.
scope.requests: Six sequential JSON-RPC POSTs maximum, one endpoint, no retries or substitutions.
scope.noOp: Empty calldata and zero value to the zero address; address code and account state are not independently proven. A successful empty return alone does not prove absence of code.
scope.blockBinding: All three capability calls use the single observed latest block NUMBER. The final reread checks its hash. This is provider-reported number binding, not a block-hash state selector, proof, finality or consensus verification.
scope.simulation: eth_simulateV1 normally constructs synthetic successor block context from the selected base; it is not claimed equal to eth_call execution in that selected block.
scope.capture: Exact sent JSON request bytes and HTTP entity response bytes after native fetch content decoding; not TLS or compressed transport bytes.
scope.dependencies: Native Node.js only. No viem invocation, asset tracing workflow, contract discovery, CCTP/deposit transaction, funds, signing, broadcast, paid endpoint or credentials.
scope.failures: Every attempted response/error is retained. Failed chain/header preparation skips dependent calls; method-specific failures do not trigger retries. A timing/byte bound can skip remaining fixed slots.
